chunks: O you people, remember the favours of God to you. Is there any creator other than God who gives you food from the heavens and the earth? There is no god but He: How then can you turn aside?
ai.seo_question: Who is the sole Creator and Provider mentioned in Surah Al-Fatirah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to emphasize God's absolute sovereignty (Al-Khaliq) and His direct provision (Ar-Razzaq) from both the celestial and terrestrial realms, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid al-Asma wa al-Sifat. It serves as a foundational argument against polytheism by highlighting that all sustenance originates from the One Creator, urging believers to maintain spiritual awareness amidst worldly distractions.
